Register a builder

Source: R/registry.R
tlf_register_table.Rd

Adds a table/listing or figure type to the dispatcher, or replaces an existing one. This lets an organization add study-specific outputs that run through the same renderers.

Usage

tlf_register_table(
  type,
  fun,
  label = type,
  class = c("Table", "Listing"),
  domains = character()
)

tlf_register_figure(type, fun, label = type)

tlf_unregister(type, kind = c("table", "figure"))

Arguments

type

Type key, for example "vitals".

fun

For tables: function(data, opts, config), where data is a named list of data frames; it must return a tlf_table_result(), a data frame, a gtsummary table or a cards card (see as_tlf_table()). For figures: function(df, ctx, opts, config); it must return a ggplot.

label

Human-readable label, for example for a selection menu.

class

For tables: "Table" or "Listing".

domains

Names of the data elements the builder reads.

kind

Which registry to remove type from.

Value

type, invisibly.

Examples

tlf_register_table("n_by_arm", function(data, opts, config) {
  n <- stat_big_n(data$adsl, "TRT01A")
  tlf_table_result(data.frame(Group = names(n), N = as.character(n)))
}, label = "Subjects by arm", domains = "adsl")
tlf_build_table("n_by_arm", list(adsl = ex_adsl))
#> <tlf_table> 4 row(s) x 2 column(s)
#>  Group      N 
#>  Drug 10 mg 20
#>  Drug 20 mg 20
#>  Placebo    20
#>  Total      60
tlf_unregister("n_by_arm")
